prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: seamless-in-framing photographic backing texture for a 3D public noticeboard, portrait 1024x1536.
Input images: Image 1 is the PRIMARY reference for the tactile layered material and density of wear. Image 2 is the current backing, shown only to explain what must be replaced: it is far too clean and empty. Generate a replacement flat texture, not a scene.
Primary request: A front-on, edge-to-edge black public noticeboard surface with decades of torn-off Taiwanese paper notices. Restore visibly accumulated history like Image 1, without copying its intact notices. NO frame, no wall, no border, no perspective, no contemporary intact posters.
Materials: approximately 40 percent exposed layered charcoal-black paint, 30 percent embedded gray/cream paper fibers and adhesive, 30 percent torn medium/large historical paper remnants. Show 20–30 individually recognizable removal and repainting events, not random uniform noise. Include about ten medium or large ragged remnants of older notices with incomplete Chinese character strokes, partial headers and phone-number fragments, the sheets mostly ripped away. These remnants are physically embedded, imperfect, and irregular, some scraped down to fibers, some painted over in black with visible horizontal and diagonal brush marks. Many yellowed tape ghosts, short tape streaks, rectangular glue footprints and pulled fiber strips overlap one another. A few tiny buried red, orange, pink and green paper bits break the restrained palette.
Composition: dense overlapping historical remnants at right center and lower right, considerable upper-left wear surrounding an older white remnant, medium density at lower left. The center is still substantially black but crossed by torn paper strips and yellowed adhesive, never a clean black empty halo. Broad patches and clustered directional scraping; avoid uniform speckles, evenly spaced fragments, decorative collage, pristine straight paper rectangles, or all history restricted to edges. History extends continuously behind where future posters will be placed.
Future composition context ONLY, do not draw these current posters: cream poster centered x=.21 y=.20; orange poster x=.69 y=.44; white poster x=.77 y=.27; white poster x=.27 y=.72; yellow poster x=.84 y=.83. These will be separate geometry over this asset. Do not clear zones for them.
Lighting: neutral diffuse daylight, physically real matte surfaces with slight natural paper thickness, no green cast, no dramatic shadows, no vignette. Close photographic material detail at full resolution. No intact contemporary notices, no frame, no people, no legible complete advertisement, no watermark.
